metrics.name: purchase_line_count
metrics.targetQuery: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM public.business_document_lines WHERE tenant_id = 'eeeeeeee-eeee-eeee-eeee-eeeeeeeeeeee' AND legacy_source_table = 'Purdetail'

metrics.name: purchase_line_quantity
metrics.sourceQuery: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(CAST(COALESCE(PackQty, 0) AS decimal(19,8)) * CASE WHEN COALESCE(PackUnits, 0) = 0 THEN CAST(1 AS decimal(19,8)) ELSE NULLIF(CAST(PackUnits AS decimal(19,8)), 0) END + CAST(COALESCE(LooseQty, 0) AS decimal(19,8))), 0) FROM dbo.Purdetail
metrics.targetQuery: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(quantity), 0) FROM public.business_document_lines WHERE tenant_id = 'eeeeeeee-eeee-eeee-eeee-eeeeeeeeeeee' AND legacy_source_table = 'Purdetail'

metrics.name: purchase_line_total
metrics.sourceQuery: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(CAST(COALESCE(rate, 0) AS decimal(19,4)) * (CAST(COALESCE(PackQty, 0) AS decimal(19,8)) * CASE WHEN COALESCE(PackUnits, 0) = 0 THEN CAST(1 AS decimal(19,8)) ELSE NULLIF(CAST(PackUnits AS decimal(19,8)), 0) END + CAST(COALESCE(LooseQty, 0) AS decimal(19,8)))), 0) FROM dbo.Purdetail
metrics.targetQuery: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(line_total), 0) FROM public.business_document_lines WHERE tenant_id = 'eeeeeeee-eeee-eeee-eeee-eeeeeeeeeeee' AND legacy_source_table = 'Purdetail'

metrics.name: purchase_line_exception_count
metrics.sourceQuery: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM dbo.Purdetail WHERE COALESCE(PackQty, 0) * CASE WHEN COALESCE(PackUnits, 0) = 0 THEN 1 ELSE PackUnits END + COALESCE(LooseQty, 0) <= 0
metrics.targetQuery: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM public.legacy_id_mappings WHERE tenant_id = 'eeeeeeee-eeee-eeee-eeee-eeeeeeeeeeee' AND source_schema = 'dbo' AND source_table = 'Purdetail' AND status = 'exception'
